t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there will be pairs of coloured gnomes. you will realise tht after a while a certain colour is paying out more. so start choosing that colour. when that starts to fail, switch to another colour.

vb_textbox.text: there seems to be a pattern, wherby a colour of gnome will give high rewards. continue with that gnome until it gives zero, then you can change to another coloured gnome.special mention for the blue gnome, i always seemed to do well with him, but that may just have been my game. good luck!
